sequenceReference.note: RED observed by MASTER: StandardRouter.handle threw TypeError when a route handler returned a Promise, so it could not compose with the async CreateCustomerHttpMessageAdapter.handle. This package makes StandardRouter.handle and AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.handle async so an async handler composes without a synchronous-object-shape mismatch.

goal: Make StandardRouter.handle an async method that awaits exactly one handler result (sync or async) before validating and returning it; short-circuit responses (400/404/405) stay deterministic frozen objects delivered through the now-async method. Make AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.handle async and await router.handle before converting the response into frozen ASGI-profile events. No server, no Python ASGI callable, no host runtime.
nonGoals: no HTTP server of any kind
no dependency, package.json or CI change
no database, PDP, tenant or CommitReceipt change
no release, deploy, readiness or product-runnable claim

standardRefs.reason: Router/profile matrix obligation: StandardRouter.handle now composes with async delivery handlers (e.g. CreateCustomerHttpMessageAdapter.handle) without a shape mismatch.
standardRefs.consumer: AsgiCoreProfileAdapter and any future host adapter

standardRefs.reason: No ASGI/Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Django/Express/Koa coupling introduced by making handle async.
standardRefs.consumer: future host conformance package (not built here)

standardRefs.reason: Mutation chain ActionSpec->PDP->ChangeSet->UoW->CommitReceipt untouched: only await/async keywords added around existing dispatch and response conversion.
Tenant isolation not inspected/enforced by this change.

red.note: Before this change, StandardRouter.handle called route.handler.handle(message) synchronously and returned its value directly; an async handler resolving a plain object made isOrdinaryObject(response) fail on the returned Promise, throwing TypeError instead of composing.

requirements: node --test tests/kernel-standard-router.test.mjs tests/kernel-asgi-core-profile.test.mjs tests/repository-boundary.test.mjs must be GREEN
npm run check must be GREEN

capabilityDelta: INTERNAL_ONLY: StandardRouter.handle and AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.handle became async so an already-existing async delivery handler (CreateCustomerHttpMessageAdapter.handle) can be dispatched through the router without a TypeError; no new route, no new host, no new endpoint reachable by any external caller, no readiness or product-runnable change.

userJourney.before: StandardRouter senkron bir handler'ı çağırıp sonucu doğrudan döndürüyordu; CreateCustomerHttpMessageAdapter.handle gibi async (Promise döndüren) bir handler'a bağlandığında TypeError fırlatıyordu, çünkü dönen değer bir Promise'ti, sıradan bir yanıt nesnesi değildi.
userJourney.after: StandardRouter.handle artık async: tam olarak bir handler sonucunu await ediyor, ister senkron ister async olsun. Kısa devre yanıtları (400/404/405) hâlâ deterministik donmuş nesneler, sadece artık async metod üzerinden teslim ediliyor. AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.handle da router.handle'ı await ediyor. Hâlâ hiçbir sunucu çalışmıyor.
userJourney.note: Bu paketle hiçbir sunucu, ASGI runtime veya framework çalışır hale gelmiyor; yalnızca StandardRouter artık async handler'larla bileşebiliyor.

kalanEngel: hiçbir gerçek host bu router'ı henüz çağırmıyor; sunucu bağlama ayrı, kapsamı belirlenecek bir paket.
